appIdea.body: # #152 Medical Practice Management (`medical-practice-management`) — Scope of Work (SOW) - **App Number:** `#152` - **App Key:** `medical-practice-management` - **Suite / Domain:** Healthcare & Wellness (`HLT` — `Hlt*`) - **Representative Benchmark (`P1`):** AdvancedMD Practice Management - **Combined Feature Set Reference:** [../combined-features/152-medical-practice-management-features.md](../combined-features/152-medical-practice-management-features.md) - **Status:** Official Architecture & Implementation Specification --- ## 1. Executive Outcome & Target Audience **Rapider Medical Practice Management (`medical-practice-management`)** eliminates front-desk registration bottlenecks, double-booked exam rooms, day-of-surgery prior authorization surprises, preventable eligibility-related claim rejections, and uncollected point-of-service copays. Acting as the operational backbone of the `HLT` suite, it orchestrates provider/facility capacity, multi-resource scheduling, primary/secondary/tertiary insurance verification (`X12 270/271`), prior authorizations (`278` / Da Vinci CRD), live exam-room flow, closed-loop referrals, and HIPAA-safe PHI-free copay handoff to `payments`. ### SME Fast-Path vs. Enterprise Progressive Disclosure - **SME Fast-Path Defaults (1–15 Provider Outpatient, Dental/Vision, PT & Behavioral Clinics):** Configure provider profiles (`HltProviderProfile`) and exam rooms (`HltClinicFacilityRoom`), manage daily/weekly multi-provider calendars and recurring therapy series (`HltAppointment`), run automated 72-hour pre-visit eligibility checks (`HltEligibilityVerification`), check in arriving patients in under 60 seconds (`HltFrontDeskCheckIn`), drag cards across the live clinic rooming `` board, and collect copays cleanly via tokenized `FinPaymentIntent` handoff. - **Enterprise Progressive Disclosure (Multi-Site Specialty Networks, Ambulatory Surgery Centers & Access Centers):** Progressively unlock coupled multi-resource scheduling rules (Surgeon + Procedure Suite + C-Arm Modality), primary/secondary/tertiary Coordination of Benefits (COB), Da Vinci CRD / `X12 278` prior authorization visit countdown gates, centralized referral conversion workqueues (`HltReferralOrder`), provider state-license/DEA expiration governance, and predictive no-show slot optimization. ### Measurable Business & Operational Outcomes 1. **<= 60-Second Front-Desk Patient Check-In** and **>= 92% Point-of-Service Copay Collection Rate** via pre-verified eligibility breakdowns and tokenized one-click payment capture. 2. **>= 80% Reduction in Front-End Eligibility & Authorization Denials** through automated 72-hour batch `X12 270/271` verification and mandatory prior-authorization visit counter checks prior to rooming. 3. **>= 15% Improvement in Provider Slot Utilization** by pairing cancellation release rules with smart waitlist and `STAT` referral slot matching. 4. **Zero Clinical PHI Leakage into General Financial Ledgers** by passing strictly opaque `POS-CHK-{uuid}` settlement tokens to `payments` (`FinPaymentIntent`). ### Top 6 Global Benchmark Summary (`P1`–`P6`) Synthesizes **AdvancedMD (`P1`)** unified multi-provider scheduling, secondary/tertiary batch eEligibility, and sub-minute check-in; **Epic Cadence & Prelude (`P2`)** multi-resource decision-tree booking, COB rigor, and Da Vinci CRD prior authorization; **ModMed (`P3`)** specialty rooming flow boards and authorized visit countdowns; **athenaOne PM (`P4`)** pre-visit network registration rule edits; **Salesforce Health Cloud (`P5`)** provider network credentialing and referral conversion; and **Microsoft Cloud for Healthcare (`P6`)** multi-facility care access and Copilot capacity insights. --- ## 2. Core End-to-End User Journeys ### Journey 1: 72-Hour Automated Batch Eligibility & Pre-Visit Financial Clearance 1. Three days before clinic day, `pm-batch-270-271-eligibility` runs automatically across all scheduled `HltAppointment`s, creating `HltEligibilityVerification` records for primary, secondary, and tertiary `HltPatientCoverage`s. 2. Out of 64 appointments, 61 return `ACTIVE_COVERED` with exact `Decimal128` copay (`\$30.00` PCP / `\$50.00` Specialist) and remaining deductible figures; 3 return `INACTIVE` or `AUTH_REQUIRED`, generating Rapider Home `WorkItem`s. 3. Patient Access Specialist opens `#/eligibility-clearance`, filters by `Result: "INACTIVE"` (`#activeFilterTagsBar`), calls the patient via `#155` or phone, updates the new employer BlueCross policy in `HltPatientCoverage`, re-runs real-time `270/271` to `ACTIVE_COVERED`, and resolves the Home `WorkItem` 48 hours before arrival. ### Journey 2: Sub-60-Second Front-Desk Check-In, PHI-Free Copay Capture & Live Exam-Room Flow 1. Patient arrives at the front desk; Receptionist opens `#/clinic-flow-board` and clicks **Check In** on the `09:30 AM` card, sliding open `#/checkin-copay-drawer`. 2. Pre-visit intake (`#155`) shows `hipaaNoticeSigned: true` and `demographicsConfirmed: true`; verified eligibility displays a `\$35.00` specialist copay and `4 of 6` authorized physical therapy visits remaining. 3. Receptionist collects `\$35.00`—`medical-practice-management` generates opaque token `POS-CHK-8f92...` and dispatches `FinPaymentIntent` to `payments` with zero patient name or clinical data. Upon settlement callback, `copayCollectedAmount` updates to `35.00`, authorized visit counter increments (`5 of 6`), and Receptionist assigns `Exam Room 3` (`ROOMED`). 4. Drawer resets button state in `finally`, clears SWR cache, auto-closes, moves the card to `ROOMED` on `` optimistically, and emits `hlt.pm.appointment.checkedIn` so `#151` stages the provider's `HltEncounterNote`. ### Journey 3: Multi-Resource Coupled Booking & Expired State License Guardrail 1. Scheduler opens `#/schedule-calendar` and launches `#/booking-drawer` to schedule a `45-minute Vascular Ultrasound + Consult`. 2. Scheduler selects `Dr. Gomez` + `Vascular Suite B`; the slot engine verifies both resources are simultaneously free and checks `HltProviderProfile.licensedStates` against the clinic's state (`NY`) and accepted payer network—confirming active credentials before committing `HltAppointment`. ### Journey 4: Cancellation Release & Smart Waitlist Backfill Handoff to `#155` 1. An afternoon dermatology slot cancels (`status: CANCELLED`); `HltAppointmentSlot.bookedCount` decrements immediately. 2. `#/referrals-waitlist` highlights 3 matching waitlisted patients and 1 `URGENT` inbound `HltReferralOrder` with verified insurance; Scheduler clicks **Offer Slot via Patient Engagement**, emitting `hlt.pm.waitlist.slotOffered` so `#155` texts the top candidate to self-confirm. ### Journey 5: Closed-Loop Specialty Referral Tracking 1. `#151` clinician signs an encounter ordering an `URGENT` Cardiology referral; `#152` creates `HltReferralOrder` (`NEW_UNSCHEDULED`). 2. Referral Coordinator attaches `X12 278` `priorAuthNumber`, books the cardiology `HltAppointment` (`SCHEDULED`), and once the cardiologist signs the consult note in `#151`, dispatches the consult summary back to the referring PCP (`LOOP_CLOSED`). ### Journey 6: List-to-Detail Click-Through & Filter State Restoration 1. Practice Manager filters `#/eligibility-clearance` by `Status: "AUTH_REQUIRED"` and searches `"Aetna"`, rendering chips `Status: "AUTH_REQUIRED" ✕` and `Search: "Aetna" ✕` in `#activeFilterTagsBar`. 2. Manager clicks `ELIG-2026-0419` -> transitions cleanly to `#/appointment-detail?id=...` to review Da Vinci CRD clinical requirements, then clicks `#btnGoBack` returning to `#/eligibility-clearance` with active filters and scroll position intact. --- ## 6. ## 1. Executive Outcome & Target Audience

**Rapider Medical Practice Management (`medical-practice-management`)** eliminates front-desk registration bottlenecks, double-booked exam rooms, day-of-surgery prior authorization surprises, preventable eligibility-related claim rejections, and uncollected point-of-service copays. Acting as the operational backbone of the `HLT` suite, it orchestrates provider/facility capacity, multi-resource scheduling, primary/secondary/tertiary insurance verification (`X12 270/271`), prior authorizations (`278` / Da Vinci CRD), live exam-room flow, closed-loop referrals, and HIPAA-safe PHI-free copay handoff to `payments`.

### SME Fast-Path vs. Enterprise Progressive Disclosure
- **SME Fast-Path Defaults (1–15 Provider Outpatient, Dental/Vision, PT & Behavioral Clinics):** Configure provider profiles (`HltProviderProfile`) and exam rooms (`HltClinicFacilityRoom`), manage daily/weekly multi-provider calendars and recurring therapy series (`HltAppointment`), run automated 72-hour pre-visit eligibility checks (`HltEligibilityVerification`), check in arriving patients in under 60 seconds (`HltFrontDeskCheckIn`), drag cards across the live clinic rooming `<rapider-kanban>` board, and collect copays cleanly via tokenized `FinPaymentIntent` handoff.
- **Enterprise Progressive Disclosure (Multi-Site Specialty Networks, Ambulatory Surgery Centers & Access Centers):** Progressively unlock coupled multi-resource scheduling rules (Surgeon + Procedure Suite + C-Arm Modality), primary/secondary/tertiary Coordination of Benefits (COB), Da Vinci CRD / `X12 278` prior authorization visit countdown gates, centralized referral conversion workqueues (`HltReferralOrder`), provider state-license/DEA expiration governance, and predictive no-show slot optimization.

1. **<= 60-Second Front-Desk Patient Check-In** and **>= 92% Point-of-Service Copay Collection Rate** via pre-verified eligibility breakdowns and tokenized one-click payment capture.
2. **>= 80% Reduction in Front-End Eligibility & Authorization Denials** through automated 72-hour batch `X12 270/271` verification and mandatory prior-authorization visit counter checks prior to rooming.
3. **>= 15% Improvement in Provider Slot Utilization** by pairing cancellation release rules with smart waitlist and `STAT` referral slot matching.
4. **Zero Clinical PHI Leakage into General Financial Ledgers** by passing strictly opaque `POS-CHK-{uuid}` settlement tokens to `payments` (`FinPaymentIntent`).

### Top 6 Global Benchmark Summary (`P1`–`P6`)
Synthesizes **AdvancedMD (`P1`)** unified multi-provider scheduling, secondary/tertiary batch eEligibility, and sub-minute check-in; **Epic Cadence & Prelude (`P2`)** multi-resource decision-tree booking, COB rigor, and Da Vinci CRD prior authorization; **ModMed (`P3`)** specialty rooming flow boards and authorized visit countdowns; **athenaOne PM (`P4`)** pre-visit network registration rule edits; **Salesforce Health Cloud (`P5`)** provider network credentialing and referral conversion; and **Microsoft Cloud for Healthcare (`P6`)** multi-facility care access and Copilot capacity insights.
